flags.summary: Prospect disclosed knee surgery, shoulder surgery, seven broken bones in her left foot and right ankle and current episodic back pain that makes her stop mid-workout; the rep asked the question, then closed the topic by minimising her answers and sold a guaranteed 8 kg load progression with no clinician clearance sought.
evidence: I've broken, just for. Full disclosure, seven bones in my left foot and my right ankle, but I've run multiple half-marathons since then... I had knee surgery, shoulder surgery
sometimes my back does like, I feel that's where I feel the most

when my trainer gives me like a 15 pound ball and I catch it and then put it up and then throw it back to hand. Like I'm, I sometimes feel it. And after that, I'll be like, give me, you know, 10 seconds. I'm just going to do a quick little back thing.
Okay. So you're fine on that front as well?
Well, that's fine then too. I'm glad you're not like, well, I've got three herniated discs and then it gets more.
the guarantee is that by the end of the six months, for the main kettlebell lifts, the three main ones, you will be using an eight kilo heavier kettlebell by the end of it

flags.summary: Asked by a female prospect whether the programme works for women, the rep answered by showing her photographs of his girlfriend's midsection on camera and commenting on her body, weight, height and ethnicity, in place of any client evidence.
evidence: But I'll show you my... This might give you a little bit of a boost in being excited, I guess. Okay. My girlfriend has been doing kettlebells for four months. Okay. You can see her abs.
She's very light. She weighs like 90 pounds
She is like, she's Asian, so she's super small. She's like 4'11", or something.
Yeah, look, I'll show you. Hold on.
Don't worry, works for women too.

flags.summary: The result guarantee was stated as an 8 kg (about 17.5 lb) increase on the three main lifts here, but as a 20 lb increase on every movement on another call by the same rep the same day, so prospects are being promised materially different things.
evidence: the guarantee is that by the end of the six months, for the main kettlebell lifts, the three main ones, you will be using an eight kilo heavier kettlebell by the end of it
It's close to 20. It's 2.2 per kilo. So it's going to be about 18 pounds or something.
But yeah, we guarantee that by the end, you'll be doing a 17-pound heavier kettlebell.
Well, that's the minimum. That's the guarantee, right? And we always guarantee less

flags.summary: Rep discussed a different prospect's case with this prospect, and separately disclosed a recent signing, using other clients as conversational material on a recorded sales call.
evidence: I spoke with a guy earlier today, and I don't want to be, I don't want to offend him or be nasty, but he was, hasn't worked out in 12 years
so yeah, I signed up a girl two days ago, maybe a little bit longer than two days, but we have women clients too
